narrative.overview: This visual system frames spatial AI tooling as an authored Swiss architectural publication and precision drafting instrument rather than a dark software telemetry panel. Every structural surface relies on pure paper whiteness, measured 1px orthogonal rules, and generous spatial cadence so photography and material color palettes carry 100% of the chromatic expression without environmental UI tinting.
keyCharacteristics: Uncast gallery paper canvas paired with 1px structural Swiss hairlines instead of bordered card clusters.
Single committed Signal Cobalt focal accent reserved exclusively for active selections, focus states, primary conversions, and curtain manipulation handles.
Complete image sovereignty on 4:3 photography plates with all metadata, OKLab swatches, and 3-slot assignment actions cleanly anchored outside the photographic frame.
Progressive disclosure: headline proof and borderless curation plates lead; 8-axis deep calibration and structured AST compilation live in focused slide-over dialogs.

rules.name: The One-Signal Restraint Rule
rules.body: Signal Cobalt (primary) appears on less than 10% of the viewport so active AST slots, the diff curtain handle, and primary CTAs read immediately without competing against the photography.

rules.name: The Uncast Neutral Plate Rule
rules.body: Curated images and OKLab swatches sit strictly on #FFFFFF or #F4F5F7 neutral grounds—never tinted dark panels—preventing optical white-balance distortion.

rules.name: The Honest Semantic Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every foreground label and button state meets or exceeds WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1), placing pure white ink over Signal Cobalt (7.2:1) and Obsidian Ink (19.0:1), and Verified Teal or Alert Crimson cleanly on Gallery Paper (>= 5.4:1).

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No user-facing text drops below 12px (0.75rem); sub-12px eyebrow tags and 9px-11px micro-badges are permanently prohibited.

rules.name: The Heading Self-Sufficiency Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry ALL-CAPS decorative eyebrow kickers above them; strong weight (700-800) and generous top margin establish hierarchy alone.

rules.name: The Hairline-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never rely on ambient gray drop-shadows or bordered rounded cards to separate panels; structure density with clean 1px Swiss grid lines and whitespace.

dos: Do keep all gallery photography 100% free of floating badges, source tags, or watermarks—place provenance and match telemetry cleanly below the frame or inside SpecimenLightbox.
Do separate dense multi-metric rows with gap-px bg-[#E2E5EA] matrices or border-t-2 border-[#0E1015] monograph rules so breakpoints wrap cleanly.
Do maintain :focus-visible rings on every custom control including range sliders and closeable role='dialog' modals (Escape + backdrop click).
Do wrap data tables in overflow-x-auto containers and preserve workspace state across tab switches.
donts: Don't place colored vertical stripes (border-l-2 / border-l-4) on the left edge of cards, pillars, or alerts.
Don't introduce two-axis background grid lines (.bg-tech-grid) behind prose or page shells; keep technical drafting grids strictly inside the TectonicLoop orthographic SVG plate.
Don't use Inter, JetBrains Mono, Space Grotesk, Playfair Display, or <12px typography classes anywhere in the interface.
Don't render raw emojis, internal sprint IDs (MIC-*, P-MIC-*), or candidate interview coaching prompts in user-facing copy.
